source.title: M.B.F.D. A.L.S. NON-TRANSPORT UNIT WEEKLY INVENTORY
notes: Transcribed from the one-page PDF als_non_transport_medical_inventory.pdf (sha256 above). Three printed columns of the same four-part table (ITEM, AMOUNT, Fill if <, NEED), read left to right and top to bottom.

Left column: Handtevy rows, Medications, I.V./NEEDLES, AIRWAY (OPA and NPA). Middle column: AIRWAY, AIRWAY / BVM Bag, TRAUMA SUPPLIES. Right column: TRAUMA SUPPLIES CONT., PPE - DECON, EKG SUPPLIES, MISCELLANEOUS, LIFE PACK INVENTORY.

The two printed AIRWAY headings (bottom of the left column and top of the middle column) are kept as two sections. The TRAUMA SUPPLIES CONT. heading is merged into TRAUMA SUPPLIES, as the Cont. headings are on the transport vehicle list.

AMOUNT is the par (min_text / min_qty / min_unit). "Fill if <" is flags.fill_if_text / fill_if_qty. NEED is blank on the sheet and is what the member enters. Differences between this sheet and the transport vehicle sheet are kept as printed (Tyvek sleeves 24 / 12, red biohazard bags 5 / 3, BVM 2 / 1, EKG paper "2 rolls" / "2 roll", disposable razors "2 pack" / "2 razors", "2 IN BOX", "5 each").

Rows marked -IN HANDTEVY- have location_text "In Handtevy". The five yellow rows marked "(1) PLACED IN BVM BAG" have location_text "Placed in BVM bag" and no AMOUNT (the sheet prints "1 in bag" under Fill if <).
The row "HANDTEVY 1st Tuesday-Monthly Inventory-Inspection completed" is a yes/no check with cadence monthly_first_tuesday. The row "HANDTEVY" (1 / 1) is a quantity item.
Two rows in the left column print AMOUNT 2 and Fill if 2 but no item name. They are not items; see review_notes.
A row that lists several variants ("Manual B/P Cuffs Adult/ Pedi", "Auto BP Cuffs XL, L, REG,, PEDI, INFANT") is one item per printed variant with the row's AMOUNT.
source.printed_header: Date: / / M.B.F.D. A.L.S. NON-TRANSPORT UNIT WEEKLY INVENTORY Unit# Revised 1-2024
review_notes: Left column, between "22GA 1.5" ADMIN NEEDLES" and "Saline flush 10cc": two table rows print AMOUNT 2 and Fill if 2 but have no item name (grid rows 55 and 56). They are not imported as items; a person should say what they are (syringes or needles, 2 each?).
Five yellow BVM bag rows (ET Tube extention, BVM CO Capnoline, i-gel 5, i-gel 4, i-gel 3) print no AMOUNT and "1 in bag" under "Fill if <". Recorded as printed (no par); flagged for review.
"Stethescope" sits in the PPE - DECON block, between "Manual B/P Cuffs Adult/ Pedi" and EKG SUPPLIES. Kept in that section.
